Date: 05-04-2026
NOTICE UNDER PARTNERSHIP ACT 1932 FOR RESOLUTION TO
DISSOLUTION VOLUNTARILY
In the matter of
M/s. MARNAZLEAD
A meeting of M/s. MARNAZLEAD duly convened and held at the registered
office of the Partnership Firm in Dhaka on 26-04-2026 at 4.00 P.M. It has been
resolved that M/s. MARNAZLEAD (CHP-4324/24, Date: 01-10-2024) has been
put into Partners for voluntary Dissolution on 26-04-2026. Md. Mosharraf
Hossain, Partner, Address: House-Master Bari, Junasar, Panshahi, P.O: Paknurpur,
Kachuwa, Chandpur, has been appointed as the Liquidator of the Firm with effect
from 26-04-2026.
All concerned are therefore, requested to contact henceforth with the Liquidator
in respect of any affairs of the Firm.
MD. MOSHARRAF HOSSAIN
Partner
M/s. MARNAZLEAD
